variants.title: Measuring a short cloth with body units
variants.sample: A strip of cloth (true length unknown to the student)
variants.method: hand span, cubit and foot step
variants.unknown: the length of the cloth in each unit
variants.note: A shorter cloth comes to fewer units of every kind, but the last part of a unit has to be estimated more carefully.

source.title: Science, Textbook for Class VI, NCERT - Motion and Measurement of Distances (hand span, cubit and foot step are not standard units)
